judgment: The king comes to the temple.
It is good to ford the great river.
It is good to hold firm.
image: So the early kings offered to the god on high
lines: Rescue with a strong horse: good.
Scattering like sweat, his great cry goes out;

notes.name_en: 渙 is dispersal, water loosened; 'Scattering', not Wilhelm's 'Dispersion (Dissolution)'.
notes.L2: 機 a support/stool to run to as the ice gives; 'your support' keeps it physical.
